span.term: Willingness to use the tools raises how often students actually use them, and sustained repeated use over time creates the conditions under which independent learning abilities develop

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Because current tools are built mainly for one-way knowledge delivery (microlectures, reading materials, practice exercises, problem-solving reviews), their interaction features do not directly stimulate usage intention and instead act only by raising satisfaction
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Interaction with classmates, teachers and the system converts into usage intention only indirectly, by first increasing students' satisfaction with the tool
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: All respondents came from a single school, limiting representativeness.
span.note: what this limits: the population every result speaks for: THE SAMPLES WERE ONLY FROM ONE SCHOOL, SO THE SCOPE WAS LIMITED AND MAY NOT BE REPRESENTATIVE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The interaction-quality construct was not broken down by type of interaction, which may mask differing effects.
span.note: what this limits: the interaction-quality finding: IT DID NOT SPECIFY THE TYPE OF INTERACTION BEING MEASURED, which may mask differing effects
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A verdict of no bias is produced by a conventional cut, and the observed value sits under it by less than four percentage points.
span.note: what this limits: the claim that common method bias is not a problem here: it rests on the largest factor accounting for 46.127% of variance against a 50% threshold
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Model fit is judged against cut-offs taken from another paper rather than derived for this design.
span.note: what this limits: the statement that this model fits: the fit indices are compared with criteria proposed by Henseler et al. (2016)

span.label: The central construct is defined by citation, in terms of what the user happens to need.
span.note: what this limits: information quality as a property of the system: it is defined as the system providing exactly what the user needs, which makes it relative to the user
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The information-quality construct and its role as a determinant of satisfaction and use are taken from the DeLone and McLean model of information systems success and applied to primary-school learning tools

span.label: A PROCEDURAL SAFEGUARD, NOT AN EXPERIMENTAL ARM: collinearity among the predictor constructs checked by variance inflation factor before the structural model is evaluated, against a threshold of VIF < 5
span.note: eliminates: collinearity as a distorter of the path coefficients - correlated predictors make individual paths unstable in sign and size, so a reported structural effect could be an artefact of the predictors overlapping rather than of the model

span.note: A PATH THE PAPER TESTED AND DID NOT FIND: 'interaction quality did not have a significant impact on intention to use', coefficient 0.097 marked NS in the structural table. NO EDGE TYPE CAN ASSERT THAT A RELATION IS ABSENT, and this is one of the study's three headline results. Second instance in two consecutive papers - arthur2022's full mediation is the same shape from the other side.

span.label: Intention to use intelligent learning tools directly predicted independent learning ability, information quality and satisfaction predicted intention to use, but interaction quality did not directly predict intention to use and instead worked through satisfaction.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Intention to use was a strong positive predictor of independent learning ability, accounting for over half its variance.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Interaction quality had no significant direct path to intention to use, making H2 the only unsupported hypothesis in the model.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Satisfaction with the tools fully mediated the effect of interaction quality on intention to use.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Satisfaction only partially mediated the information-quality path, since information quality also retained a significant direct effect on intention to use.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Students rated the information quality of the tools higher than their interaction quality, which the authors use to explain why interaction quality did not drive usage intention.
